name: outreach.intro
description: Project Get a Job: gate a warm-intro message to a recruiter, hiring manager, or a 1st-degree connection being asked for an introduction. Outbound is irreversible.

sells_rig.instructions: The message pitches Rodgers Intelligence Group, consulting services, or a fractional engagement instead of expressing interest in the job as an employee

single_clear_ask.instructions: The message contains exactly one specific ask the reader can act on in under a minute

forwardable.instructions: A recruiter or connection could forward this message unchanged and the recipient would understand who the candidate is and why they fit in one read

comp_or_private_leak.instructions: The message states salary numbers, names other companies the candidate is interviewing with, or includes private details that belong in a later conversation

generic_template.instructions: The message could have been sent to any company; nothing in it is specific to this role, team or person

rules.reason: consulting pitch in a job-search message
too long for a cold read

notes: Sending stays gated by Mike's daily approval regardless of verdict. Rank verb picks among 3 drafted variants; check annotates the winner.
